主要内容: On May 1, 2019, the Federal Reserve Board issued an Implementation Note outlining the decisions made to implement the monetary policy stance announced by the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC). The Board of Governors voted unanimously to set the interest rate paid on required and excess reserve balances at 2.35 percent, effective May 2, 2019. This rate was set 15 basis points below the top of the target range for the federal funds rate to foster trading within the FOMC's target range. The FOMC also authorized the Open Market Desk at the Federal Reserve Bank of New York to execute transactions in the System Open Market Account, maintaining the federal funds rate within a target range of 2-1/4 to 2-1/2 percent. The Desk was directed to conduct overnight reverse repurchase operations at an offering rate of 2.25 percent, with limits based on Treasury securities holdings and a $30 billion per day per-counterparty cap. Additionally, the Desk was instructed to roll over principal payments exceeding $15 billion and reinvest in agency mortgage-backed securities exceeding $20 billion. The primary credit rate was also maintained at 3.00 percent.

股票实体.名称: Federal Reserve Bank of New York
